name: 12065 · Clifton Park, NY
findings: ZIP 12065 (Clifton Park) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12065 (Clifton Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12065 (Clifton Park) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
